changes.title: Arrive fix
items: Sailing to an island: the fly-in now plays in full after the island loads, instead of cutting straight to your decks
While the island loads, the chart's last picture stays up with a "landing…" note

changes.title: Sigil glow
items: Sigils on the ground are easier to read: no more glow washing them into a bright blob on lit grass
The same calmer sigils in your stack, from the treetops, and on a creature walking home

changes.title: Chart moon
items: On the map table the moon rises over the north-west edge as it opens, then circles slowly, and every island casts its shadow across the sea
The map table has open sea round its edge
